name: MyLogoQR - Branded QR Code Studio
short_description: Create branded QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts, and WhatsApp.
long_description: Create QR codes inside ChatGPT for links, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, and digital business cards. Customize foreground and background colors. Inputs are sent to the MyLogoQR service for QR generation.
example_prompts: Create a custom emerald-green QR code for my website https://mybusiness.com
Generate a Wi-Fi QR code so guests can easily connect to my HomeNet
Make a digital vCard QR code with my contact info and phone number
Generate a WhatsApp QR code with a pre-filled message for customer support
